jobs.title: Product Owner - Customer Ops  Customer Analytics
jobs.description:
The Product Owner, Customer Engagement Data & Analytics, is responsible for defining, delivering, and continuously improving data and analytics products that support Contact Center and Omnichannel insights. This role connects business needs, customer behavior, operational data, and emerging technology to create solutions that improve service performance, agent effectiveness, and our customers experience when interacting with Con Edison. The Product Owner partners with business stakeholders, technology teams, data engineers, analysts, and operational leaders to establish product priorities, manage the product roadmap, produce detailed product requirements, and ensure analytics solutions deliver measurable value.
Required Education/Experience - High School Diploma/GED and 10+ years of work experience or
- Associate's Degree and 8 years of work experience or
- Bachelor's Degree and 5 years of work experience

Relevant Work Experience - 3-5 years of work experience with agile project management, required.
- Experience with Microsoft office applications, including proficiency with Excel or Power BI, required.
- Knowledge of Con Edison Customer Operations Contact Center, customer service, IVR, omnichannel or workforce operations, required.
- Experience with SQL, Python or other programming languages, required.
- Previous experience working with vendors, required.
- Experience with managing a cross functional team of employees and vendors, required.
- Proven ability to manage multiple assignments and changing priorities, required.
- Must have excellent oral and written communications skills, required.
- Knowledge of contact center performance metrics and operational processes, preferred.
- Experience with predictive analytics, customer behavior analysis, IVR analytics or agent enablement solutions, preferred.
- Experience with data enrichment, dashboards, reporting platforms, or customer data products, preferred.
- Experience with various Company and Customer Operations computer systems, preferred.
- Knowledge of Customer Operations business, rules and regulations, preferred.
- Knowledge of O&R customer Assistance, preferred.
- Experience in producing formal presentations and documentation for executive and regulatory share out, preferred.
- Experience managing a agile product development team as a Product Owner, preferred.
- Work toward achieving Con Edison's AI for Practitioner Certification, preferred.

Skills and Abilities - Demonstrated analytical skills
- Demonstrated written communication skills
- Well organized, detail oriented and flexible to handle multiple assignments

Licenses and Certifications - Driver's License Required

Additional Physical Demands - The selected candidate will be assigned a System Emergency Assignment (i.e., an emergency response role) and will be expected to work non-business hours during emergencies, which may include nights, weekends, and holidays.

- Project Demonstrated project management skills.
- Must be proficient in Microsoft Office including Word, Excel, Power BI, Outlook and PowerPoint, etc.
Core Responsibilities - Lead the development and delivery of analytics products that support Contact Center and Omnichannel customer engagement operations
- Establish product roadmaps and prioritize enhancements based on business value, customer impact, operational needs, and technical feasibility.
- Create user stories, features, and epics associated with contact center, mobile, web and IVR data analytics while working with business and ETS stakeholders to appropriate groom product backlogs
- Write user stories and acceptance criteria that are clear, concise and easy to understand, driven by VOC and provide business value.

- Manage the product delivery lifecycle to ensure products are delivered on time with clear value expectations and change management

jobs.title: Clean Energy Data Product Owner - BEUP
jobs.description:
Con Edison, a multibillion-dollar energy utility, is leading the clean energy transition in New York City and Westchester County. We are investing hundreds of millions of dollars annually to integrate distributed resources into our electric and gas systems, support electric vehicle charging infrastructure, and scale adoption of energy efficiency and clean heating technologies across our customers.

The Clean Energy Data Product Owner will lead the Building Energy Usage Portal (BEUP), Con Edisons customer-facing data platform that provides aggregated building energy usage information to support benchmarking, Local Law compliance, customer energy insights, and future clean energy planning needs. This role requires a strong leader who can manage people, projects, vendors, administrative responsibilities, customer relationships, and governmental stakeholder needs while also understanding and managing software delivery, data quality, application operations, and regulatory obligations. The successful candidate will be able to organize ambiguous issues, drive resolution across teams, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, and ensure BEUP remains reliable, accurate, customer-centered, and positioned for future modernization.
Required Education/Experience - Master's Degree and a minimum of two years relevant experience or
- Bachelor's Degree and a minimum of three years relevant experience or
- Associate's Degree and a minimum of five years relevant experience or
- High School Diploma/GED and a minimum of seven years relevant experience

Preferred Education/Experience - Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, Business, or applicable degree and three years related work experience in people leadership, project or program management, customer-facing operations, public-facing stakeholder engagement, software or data product delivery, clean energy, utility operations, or a related digital product environment.

Relevant Work Experience - Experience leading teams, assigning work, coaching employees, coordinating matrixed resources, managing priorities, resolving escalations, and driving accountability across people, projects, vendors, and operational responsibilities, required.
- Experience managing customer-facing or public-facing services, including direct customer engagement, customer service operations, issue escalation, stakeholder communications, and relationships with governmental, regulatory, municipal, or political entities, required.
- Experience managing projects, programs, administrative processes, budgets, forecasts, vendor coordination, resource plans, governance routines, executive reporting, and delivery tradeoffs, required.
- Experience understanding software delivery and data concepts, including requirements gathering, process design, testing, release readiness, Agile/Scrum delivery, data validation, system integrations, dashboards, and production support, required.
- Strong communication, presentation, writing, facilitation, judgment, problem solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to organize ambiguous issues and drive practical resolution, required.
- Experience managing product or operational metrics, data quality indicators, service levels, customer support trends, executive status reporting, and performance improvement actions, required.
- Experience with clean energy, energy efficiency, benchmarking, Local Law 84, Local Law 97, CLCPA, customer energy data, utility operations, or regulated business processes, required.
- Experience with Salesforce, Power BI, Azure DevOps, Energy Star Portfolio Manager, C3, AMI, CC&B, SQL, data governance, or other customer, utility, software, or data platforms, required.
- Experience producing public-facing, regulatory, executive, or governmental communications, including briefing materials, customer notices, stakeholder presentations, and formal documentation, required

Licenses and Certifications - Driver's License Required
- Other: Data Management, Governance, Professional (CDMP) Preferred
- Other: Agile, SAFe Agile

Additional Physical Demands - The selected candidate will be assigned a System Emergency Assignment (i.e., an emergency response role) and will be expected to work non-business hours during emergencies, which may include nights, weekends, and holidays.
- The selected candidate will be assigned a System Emergency Assignment (i.e., an emergency response role) and will be expected to work non-business hours during emergencies, which may include nights, weekends, and holidays.
- Strong oral and written communication skills.
- Demonstrated analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to manage multiple assignments, prioritize work, and meet deadlines.
- Ability to build effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
- Experience with software delivery, testing, release readiness, and production support processes.
- Ability to interpret data quality issues, system defects, dashboards, reports, and customer usage data.
Core Responsibilities - Lead BEUP as a customer-facing clean energy data platform by setting direction, priorities, operating expectations, modernization plans, and performance goals in alignment with business, regulatory, customer, and Digital Products objectives.
- Manage BEUP employees and matrixed resources, including coaching, work assignment, prioritization, performance support, issue escalation, cross-training, vendor coordination, administrative routines, budgets, forecasts, and delivery risks.
- Serve as the primary relationship owner for direct customer, governmental, municipal, regulatory, and external stakeholder interactions, including NYC agency coordination, Local Law and benchmarking inquiries, customer escalations, public-facing communications, and stakeholder issue resolution.
- Translate customer, regulatory, operational, and business needs into clear requirements, decision documents, process flows, work plans, testing expectations, release materials, executive updates, regulatory inputs, and stakeholder communications.
- Lead software, data, and operational delivery with IT, data engineering, Agile delivery teams, vendors, customer operations, and business partners from concept through release, adoption, production support, and continuous improvement.
- Oversee BEUP data quality, operating controls, metrics, issue resolution, and service performance, including consumption variances, estimate replacement, meter-to-property relationships, ESPM exchanges, source-system discrepancies, customer-reported issues, platform reliability, SLAs, adoption, and reporting accuracy.

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst, Privacy Operations - Customer Operations Regulatory & Compliance
jobs.description:
The Privacy Operations team works to enhance the enterprise privacy program supporting both Con Edison and Orange & Rockland in response to growing customer expectations, risk management imperatives, and current/evolving legal obligations around the collection, storage, processing, and sharing of personal data. In partnership with Enterprise Technology Services, the team is responsible for implementing and managing the technology using the OneTrust platform and the supporting business processes to create a "privacy by design" culture that embeds privacy protection and controls throughout the lifecycle of the data.

The Senior Product Analyst will be responsible for supporting the Product Owners with project and features development and communications, including the projects roadmap, backlog prioritization, project plans, resource utilization schedules and budget materials.
Required Education/Experience - Master's Degree and 2 years of related work experience or
- Bachelor's Degree and 3 years of related work experience or
- Associate's Degree and 5 years of related work experience

Relevant Work Experience - Experience as an analyst or part of a product team on technology implementation projects, required.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively with teammates and stakeholders to drive results and build consensus, required.
- Capable of managing multiple priorities and deadlines with attention to detail, required.
- Experience developing and delivering presentations and creating clear documentation for diverse audiences, required.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and related tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, Azure DevOps), required.
- Previous work in utilities or other heavily regulated industries, preferred.
- Familiarity with agile program management, preferred.
- Experience with change management and training, preferred.

Skills and Abilities - Demonstrated problem solving skills
- Excellent collaboration and team building skills

Licenses and Certifications - Driver's License Required
- Other: PMP, CCMP, or Prosci Certifications Preferred
- Other: Agile or Scrum certification(s) Preferred
- Other: OneTrust Privacy Professional certification Preferred
- Other: IAPP CIPP-US, CIPM, or CIPT certification Preferred

Additional Physical Demands - The selected candidate will be assigned a System Emergency Assignment (i.e., an emergency response role) and will be expected to work non-business hours during emergencies, which may include nights, weekends, and holidays.
